sn24.96:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.96:2.1: rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.96:2.6: viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.96:4.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ …pe… sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn24.96:4.5: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ …pe… sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn24.96:5.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati, saññāyapi nibbindati, saṅkhāresupi nibbindati, viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati.
sn24.96:5.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn24.96:5.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
sn24.96:6.1: so attā no ca me siyā, natthi karato hetu
sn24.96:6.2: ca mahādiṭṭhena aṭṭhamaṃ. sassato asassato ceva antā nantā ca
sn24.96:6.3: vuccati, taṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃjīvañca tathāgatena cattāro, rūpī attā yathā
sn24.96:6.4: hoti arūpī ca tathāpare. neva rūpī nārūpinā ekantasukhī attā
sn24.96:6.5: ca, ekantadukkhī sukhadukkhī adukkhamasukhī cā ti.
